patterns.note: Organic, wavy section dividers are used consistently to separate content blocks, creating a soft, flowing visual rhythm across the page.
A distinctive, friendly display serif font is used for primary headlines, contrasted with clean, often uppercase sans-serif fonts for subheadings and body text.
A vibrant and fresh color palette centers on a deep teal/green, complemented by a warm cream background and bright yellow accents for calls to action.

The top announcement bar disappears on scroll, while the main navigation becomes sticky and gains a solid background. Content sections appear to reveal themselves with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport.
Full-bleed product photography and playful, custom illustrations are integrated directly into section backgrounds and content blocks.

technique_notes: The site employs a combination of CSS keyframes and GSAP for scroll-triggered animations. A top announcement bar is hidden as the user scrolls down, while the primary navigation bar transitions to a sticky state with a solid background. Content sections are revealed with a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated by GSAP ScrollTrigger to enhance engagement.
Wavy section dividers are implemented using SVG shapes or CSS clip-paths, allowing for dynamic and organic transitions between different background colors and content areas.
Product displays utilize clean, focused photography with minimal text overlays, often presented in a grid or carousel format, allowing the product's visual appeal to dominate.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized friendly display headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, often uppercase sans-serif labels and clean body text.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between main sections and a more compact grid for product listings.

standout: The distinctive use of organic, wavy section dividers combined with playful, hand-drawn illustrations and a vibrant, yet sophisticated color palette creates a unique brand identity that feels both healthy and fun, moving beyond typical health food aesthetics.
